name: Classy Chicken
description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Chicken and Croutons
_similar.description: A creamy chicken casserole topped with Swiss cheese and crunchy croutons.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Rinse the chicken and pat dry, then arrange in a 9×13 inch baking dish.
Top each chicken fillet with a slice of Swiss cheese.
Combine the cream of chicken soup, mushrooms, and milk in a bowl; mix well.
Spread the soup mixture over the chicken.
Toss the croutons with melted butter in a small bowl.
Sprinkle the buttered croutons over the casserole.
Bake, covered with foil, for 1 hour.
Bake, uncovered, for an additional 15 minutes until the top is browned.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, croutons, creamy chicken bake

_similar.name: Spaghetti Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti casserole with ground beef, canned tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of mushroom soup

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef and onion in a frying pan.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Transfer cooked spaghetti to a 2-quart casserole dish.
Pour canned tomatoes over the spaghetti layer.
Spoon the browned meat mixture over the tomatoes.
Cover with cream of mushroom soup.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, uncovered, until cheese starts to get bubbly.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti casserole, ground beef, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Favourite Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and satisfying chicken dish baked with cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, and garlic.
recipeIngredient: 1 can cheddar cheese soup (or other soup to taste)

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and pat dry chicken breasts.
Combine cheddar cheese soup, mushroom soup, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Place chicken in a 9x11 inch baking dish. Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Top with grated cheese and sliced mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour for 4 pieces or 1½ hours for 6 pieces.
Check to ensure chicken is cooked through, as oven temperatures may vary.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
_similar.description: Thinly sliced baking potatoes baked with cheddar cheese and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into ¼ inch slices

recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, paprika, and pepper.
Arrange potato slices in overlapping rows in a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the potatoes.
Spoon the soup mixture evenly over the cheese.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until potatoes are fork-tender.

_similar.keywords: baked potatoes, cheddar cheese, creamy sauce

_similar.name: Curry Chicken

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix all ingredients except chicken breasts in a microwave-safe bowl until butter is melted.
Arrange chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish sprayed with nonstick spray.
Pour the curry mixture over the chicken breasts.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice.

_similar.keywords: curry chicken, baked chicken, honey mustard chicken
